rendered: The variant that retained the most capacity after cycling at C/3 was NFA-A, which the paper reports at ≈80% capacity retention after 100 cycles at C/3[1], ahead of NFA 811[2] (≈70%)[3] and NFA-F (≈50%) variants[4]. NFA-A is the composition LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[5]. Its aluminium content is 15% Al[6], and its iron content is the Fe subscript shown in that same formula. Table 1[7] has no row named NFA-A; its aluminium-rich row is Al-rich NFA[8], and for that row the c lattice parameter is 14.2232(4)[9].
